gametypes.name: Sticks and Stones
gametypes.description: Free-for-all with the crossbow, a knife and a throwing knife. A throwing knife kill bankrupts the victim.
gametypes.objective: Get kills with the crossbow and the knife. A throwing knife kill or a suicide resets the score to 0.
